mapper.select: SELECT id, topic_id, captured_by_member_id, request_id, source_config_version, content_hash, canonical_json, state, contract_version, canonicalization_version FROM content_capture_snapshot WHERE topic_id=#{topicId} AND captured_by_member_id=#{memberId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_capture_snapshot (topic_id, captured_by_member_id, request_id, source_config_version, content_hash, canonical_json, state, contract_version, canonicalization_version) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{capturedByMemberId}, #{requestId}, #{sourceConfigVersion}, #{contentHash}, #{canonicalJson}, 'FROZEN_INCOMPLETE', 'questify.content-capture-candidate.v1', 'questify.canonical-content-json.v1')
